Job Description
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON
Main challenge

You will help build and improve a kid-safe AI chatbot in a children's app that is live in many languages. Your main focus is the LLM-powered chatbot. Its answers must be friendly, consistent, age-appropriate and safe in every supported language. Depending on project needs, you will also work on computer vision (recognizing real-world toys), generative illustration pipelines, and translation and text-to-speech automation.
What it means on a daily basis

• Build and improve AI chatbot experiences: Design, test, and refine prompts and conversation flows to ensure the chatbot delivers natural, consistent, and age-appropriate responses across supported languages.
• Develop AI safety mechanisms: Build and improve safety guardrails, including input/output filters, topic restrictions, and fallback responses to protect children from inappropriate or unsafe content.
• Experiment with and optimize LLMs: Test new models, frameworks, and techniques, evaluate their performance, and optimize API usage for cost, latency, and response quality.
• Build AI automation tools: Develop Python scripts to automate translation and text-to-speech workflows, incorporating validation and quality checks.
• Evaluate, document, and collaborate: Build evaluation datasets, track experiment results, document AI workflows, and work with AI Engineers, Developers, and Content Teams to bring features from prototype to production.

Who you would be working with

• AI engineers, Unity developers, QA and content teams
• Cross-functional and international teams, depending on project needs

Qualifications
WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Solid Python programming skills, particularly in scripting, data handling, and API integration.
• Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), including LLM API integration, prompt engineering, or basic RAG/agent projects.
• Basic understanding of Machine Learning and Computer Vision concepts, particularly classification and object detection.
• At least one practical AI project (personal, academic, or internship) with code or a demo to showcase.
WHO YOU ARE

• Curious and eager to explore: You enjoy experimenting with new AI models, tools, and techniques, and are motivated to keep learning in this fast-evolving field.
• Versatile and adaptable: You're comfortable switching between LLM development, automation, and other AI-related tasks.
• Detail-oriented: You care about output quality, consistency, and especially the safety of AI-generated content for children.
• Analytical and structured: You approach experiments systematically and enjoy documenting results, evaluating performance, and learning from failures.
• Proactive and solution-oriented: You can identify potential issues, suggest improvements, and take initiative to solve problems.
Your recruitment journey

• (1) Screening call
• (2) Test (5 days)
• (3) Interview (onsite)

Additional Information
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
Benefits

• Internship allowance from VND 6,000,000 gross/month (based on candidates' competencies and committed working days).
• 1 day of paid annual leave per month, Christmas leave, Birthday leave, CSR leave, paid sick leave.
• Various training packages, including internal training and e-learning platforms (iLearn, Udemy, O'Reilly,...).
• Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourselves.
• A range of well-being events and policies to support employees physically, mentally, and emotionally.
• The opportunity to become an official employee of Gameloft.
Life at Gameloft

• A collaborative workplace environment, with over 15+ nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born.
• An open-space office, a canteen, a billiard table, a ping-pong table, and a foosball table.
• A gaming room equipped with mutiple devices (PS, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, arcade machine,...).
• A capable and encouraging team of professionals focused on creating compelling video games.
• A global company where you can meet great people around the world.
• A fun place to work in the heart of the city.
How to proceed
Ready to level up your career? Apply now and help us create the next great game!
